notesStmt.note: The leaf on which this draft appears is comprised, in part, of an envelope on which appears a postmark for February 18, 1885, and it is likely that Whitman wrote it between that date and February 22, when the poem was published in the Philadelphia Press under the title "Ah, Not This Granite Dead and Cold." Because the earliest writing on the leaf was done in pencil, and all of the lines on the envelope scrap are in ink, it is possible that the top part of the manuscript was begun somewhat earlier.

This poem was originally published as "Ah, Not This Granite Dead and Cold" in the Philadelphia Press on February 22, 1885. Whitman later revised it as "Washington's Monument, February, 1885" for the "Sands at Seventy" section of November Boughs (1888).
